title: Consonant blends (CCVC/CVCC)
examples: Teacher, what is the difference between a blend and a digraph?
Can you show me some words with 'st' at the beginning?
How do I know when to use a blend instead of a digraph?

explain.say: In stop, the letters s and t are next to each other. You hear both sounds.
Two consonant sounds said together are called a blend. In frog, you hear f, then r.
Blends can come at the end of a word too. In hand, you hear n, then d.
In lamp, you hear m, then p, at the end.
A digraph is different. The letters s and h make one new sound, sh.
St is a blend, because you hear two sounds. Sh is a digraph, because you hear one sound.

faq.q: What is the difference between a blend and a digraph?
faq.a: In a blend, you can hear two separate consonant sounds. In a digraph, two letters make one single new sound.
asks: How do I tell if it is a blend or a digraph?

faq.q: Do all blends have to be at the beginning of a word?
faq.a: No, blends can happen at the beginning, middle, or end of a word. They just need to be together.
asks: Can blends be at the end?
Where can I find consonant blends?

faq.q: Is 'th' a blend or a digraph?
faq.a: The letters 'th' usually make one sound, so it is a digraph. You hear one sound when you say it.

faq.q: How many sounds are in the blend 'bl'?
faq.a: The blend 'bl' has two distinct sounds. You can hear the 'b' sound and the 'l' sound separately.
asks: Can you say the sounds in 'bl'?

faq.q: What is the difference between 'c' and 'ck'?
faq.a: Both make the sound k. You often write ck straight after a short vowel at the end of a word, as in duck and sock.

facts: A blend keeps the sounds of each letter separate.
A digraph combines two letters to make one sound.
Blends can include sounds like st, fr, bl, or tr.
Digraphs are pairs like sh, ch, or th.

quiz.say: Look at the picture. Tap the letters for its first two sounds.
quiz.why: Frog starts with two sounds, f then r. Together they are written fr.

wrong.1: You hear f first, and then you also hear r.
wrong.2: The letters fl make f then l, but this word has f then r.

quiz.say: Read the words. Tap the word with a digraph.
quiz.why: In ship, the letters s and h make one sound, sh.

wrong.0: In stop, you hear two sounds, s then t, so st is a blend.
wrong.2: In frog, you hear two sounds, f then r, so fr is a blend.

quiz.say: Listen to tent. Tap the letters for its last two sounds.
quiz.why: Tent ends with n, then t. Together they are written nt.

wrong.0: You hear t at the end, and you hear n just before it.
wrong.1: The letters nd end the word hand, but this word ends with t.
